description: Rung 2 of DETERMINEX_LIVE_REACT_PRODUCT_SHELL_DEMO_READINESS_SERIES. Binds the React Idea Lab panel to the Codex Idea Lab verified Python CLI splash demo evidence (lock DETERMINEX_IDEA_LAB_PYTHON_CLI_VERIFIED_SPLASH_DEMO_LOCK_001). Adds a read-only Tauri command get_idea_lab_verified_demo_status, a Python loader at scripts/ide/idea_lab_verified_demo_status.py, and a React component at frontend/src/components/ide-product-shell/IdeaLabVerifiedDemoStatus.tsx. The loader reads the most recent run_*.json under assurance/evidence/idea_lab_python_cli_verified_splash_demo/ and returns PASSED only if (1) source_mutation_authorized != True, (2) training_eligible != True, (3) approval_authority_granted != True, (4) claim_boundary includes the required scope statements ('Python CLI/file-data demo only', 'not all apps', 'not any language', 'training remains false'), (5) no affirmative forbidden broad-claim phrase appears outside the blocked_path_demo subsection, and (6) verified_working_local_app=True implies tests_passed AND smoke_passed. If the evidence file is not present locally, returns AWAITING_EVIDENCE; the React component surfaces an 'Awaiting Codex reconciliation' banner rather than fake a verified status. The component renders demo title, app class, target language, verified-for-fixture-only status, tests/smoke pass, evidence ref, claim boundary, training-false badge, and Ready-does-NOT-mean-authorized caption. It NEVER surfaces all-app / any-language / production-ready-arbitrary / training-enabled / source-mutation-authorized / no-followup / release-ready claims.
